# attestto.org

> Public marketing and open-source ecosystem site for Attestto, built with Astro.

Part of the [Attestto Open](https://attestto.org) ecosystem.

## What it is

The public-facing website at [attestto.org](https://attestto.org). Presents Attestto Open as public digital infrastructure for verifiable data -- open schemas, decentralized identifiers, and cryptographic verification. Bilingual (English + Spanish). Deployed to GitHub Pages.

This is a private Astro site, not a published npm package.

## Key pages

- `/` -- Home page: mission, principles, architecture overview
- `/why` -- Why Attestto exists
- `/standards` -- DID methods and open standards
- `/downloads` -- Desktop app downloads
- `/modules/` -- Module catalog
- `/docs/` -- Documentation section
- `/ark/` -- Ark identity pages
- `/cr/` -- Costa Rica country-specific pages
- `/for/` -- Audience-specific pages (governments, developers, etc.)
- `/es/` -- Spanish translations
- `/.well-known/did.json` -- W3C DID document for `did:web:attestto.org`
- `/.well-known/governance.json` -- Governance manifest (Squads v4 multisig)

## Source layout

```
src/
  pages/          -- Astro pages (.astro files)
    index.astro   -- Home page
    why.astro     -- Why page
    standards.astro
    downloads.astro
    ark/          -- Ark identity pages
    cr/           -- Costa Rica pages
    docs/         -- Documentation pages
    es/           -- Spanish translations
    for/          -- Audience pages
    modules/      -- Module catalog pages
  components/     -- Reusable Astro components
  layouts/        -- Page layouts
  styles/         -- CSS (design tokens)
  data/           -- Static data files
```

## Build

```bash
pnpm build    # Astro static build
pnpm test     # Vitest (includes i18n parity test)
```

## Design principles

- Bilingual EN/ES with i18n parity testing
- SSR-safe (no unguarded browser APIs)
- Design tokens via CSS custom properties (no hardcoded colors)
- SEO-hardened with sitemap generation (@astrojs/sitemap)

## DID identity

The site hosts `did:web:attestto.org` at `/.well-known/did.json`, governed by a Squads v4 multisig (2-of-3) on Solana mainnet-beta.

## Related repos

- [`attestto-app`](https://github.com/Attestto-com/attestto-app) -- Authenticated app at app.attestto.com
- [`vc-sdk`](https://github.com/Attestto-com/vc-sdk) -- Verifiable credentials SDK
- [`cr-vc-schemas`](https://github.com/Attestto-com/cr-vc-schemas) -- JSON-LD credential schemas
- [`did-method-checklist`](https://github.com/Attestto-com/did-method-checklist) -- DID method evaluation tool
